built: 2026-11-18 09:30 PT, 13 cases added 2026-11-18 PM (data answers without AI, follow-up fixes)
grounding: Facts come from https://www.fremontasb.org/api/sheet?tab=Events|Sports|Spirit%20Points, /api/clubs and /api/announcements fetched 2026-11-18 09:26-09:28 PT (snapshot in fixtures/), plus SCHEDULES, NO_CLASSES and SPECIAL_DAYS in FirebirdHub/app.js and STATIC_FACTS in FirebirdHub/api/ask.js.

format.now: the moment the question is asked (Pacific time). Sent as x-felipe-now to the dev server; used as data.now in --core mode. Default: defaults.now.
format.expected_route: local | llm | cannot | crisis (the client-side route FelipeCore.classify should pick). also_ok_routes lists routes that are acceptable too.
format.must_include: every entry must appear in the answer (case-insensitive). An entry that is an array means any one of its strings.
format.must_not_include: none of these may appear. run.mjs also applies global_must_not_include to every answer.
format.context.assignments: a list of ids from assignment_bank; run.mjs swaps each id for the item (without its id) before sending, as the shape { title, type, due, desc, url }.
format.representative: true for the 15 cases used for real Gemini latency (run.mjs --representative).
format.no_ai: true: in --inproc mode the case runs with no AI key, so it checks the answer made from the data (what students get when every AI provider is out).
